reuse.why: Introduces a shared getMonthWideCategories that four actions use and reuses setNMonthAvg, but parses #fixed with its own regex instead of the shared tags helpers (extractTagsFromText) and reads goal_def itself instead of the template loader.

duplication.why: Collapses the three copied category queries and the avg actions into one selection and setAllCategoriesAvg, but copyPreviousMonth re-implements the whole selection (income, hidden, templated, fixed) inline.

placement.why: The selection rule sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, but the #fixed filter is also pushed into goal-template.ts's template run, which is not a month-wide action.

scope.why: Mostly on-request, but it changes which categories budget templates are applied to (goal-template.ts) and switches the averaging actions from void to awaited calls, neither of which was asked.

maintainability.why: One selection function is an improvement, yet the rule now lives in two places (getMonthWideCategories and copyPreviousMonth's loop), so the next exclusion has to be added twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/templated/#fixed/income exclusions itself instead of using getMonthWideCategories; getFixedGroupCategoryIds hand-rolls tag matching instead of shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's per-row checks restate getMonthWideCategories' filter in a different shape (row fields hidden/group_hidden plus templated/fixed sets) rather than sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gained includeHiddenCategories (step 4, interpolated into its SQL); copyPreviousMonth bypasses it and re-implements every exclusion step by step.
